security_level.words: The neighbour the guard reads, the IRPT_BCKEND gold table holdings_performance_daily, is account grain: its 2026-04-21 partition carries 19 columns, none a security identifier, a price or a price-source column, and its producer's emitted column list is account grain (one row per account). The account_return_daily partition is account grain too. No security-grain price return or price source exists in the holdings gold for this firm and day, so the account-level profile stands as the answer.

positive_control.description: four synthetic (account, security) pairs through the selection function: a flat price with a moving position, an absent price with a moving position, a moving price, and an excluded security with a flat price

method_words: Read the round 118 flow-guard record for its first date (2026-04-21): VALUE 941 plus FLOW_AND_VALUE 2 gives value_rows 943. Read two IRPT_BCKEND gold partitions of the 49 Financial firm for 2026-04-21, addressed by lib opal_naming address() for account_return_daily and holdings_performance_daily, with two GET calls and no other read. Profiled the GRADED_DISAGREED accounts of account_return_daily against the holdings_performance_daily partition: 943 accounts, every one holds a holdings row, every holdings status is OK, excluded_count is zero for 937 and above zero for 6, and excluded_weight is zero or null for all 943, so no account falls in the 1-to-10 percent or above-10 percent bands. The security level is ABSENT: the holdings gold is account grain, and its partition has no security identifier, price or price-source column. Producer read (data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/account_return_daily.py): HOLDINGS_TABLE at line 185; the neighbour read at lines 993 to 1019 takes daily_return only when the holdings status is OK; guard_state_of at line 1068. In one paragraph: for the 943 accounts the holdings gold reports status OK and a zero or null excluded weight, so the excluded-security channel does not explain the cohort; the gold carries no per-security price return, so the gold cannot say which holdings price moved or failed to move on the day, and that question stays open for a later round.
